$comment: Every content key the reference mod (BalatroMultiplayerPvP) registers, or defines in a comment block, with its native counterpart. Generated once from the mod checkout by scanning every SMODS/MPAPI/PVP constructor (Joker, Consumable, Tag, Blind, Voucher, Back, Stake, Sticker, Booster, Challenge, Layer, Ruleset, ReworkCenter) and take_ownership call; loop-defined keys are expanded. spec/mp_content_inventory_spec.lua (objects, stickers, stakes, reworks) and lib/balatro/mp/rulesets/__tests__/mod-inventory.test.ts (layers, rulesets) fail when a native counterpart is missing. `excluded` lists what has none (empty since EX-14, EX-16, EX-17 and the Judgement rework were lifted), each with the docs/balatro-mp-parity.md EX id that says why ("inert": commented out with no effect to port). Update it with the mod.
